pull.title: MINOR: Acquire RefreshingHttpsJwks lock before entering try block
pull.body:
The lock() calls in RefreshingHttpsJwks were made inside the try block. If lock() threw, the finally block would call unlock() on a lock that was never acquired, throwing IllegalMonitorStateException and masking the original error.

Move lock() before try at all four sites, following the standard java.util.concurrent.locks idiom.

MINOR: Acquire RefreshingHttpsJwks lock before entering try block

The lock() calls in RefreshingHttpsJwks were made inside the try block.
If lock() threw, the finally block would call unlock() on a lock that
was never acquired, throwing IllegalMonitorStateException and masking
the original error.

Move lock() before try at all four sites, following the standard
java.util.concurrent.locks idiom.

Signed-off-by: Tamás Barnabás Egyed <egyed.t@cloudera.com>
